tools.name: get_image
tools.description: Get one image's full record by ID - a meme, chart, infographic or screenshot: caption, alt text, tags, the words printed in it (OCR text), its source and licence (rights), a ready citation and URLs. For a chart that is part of a series, chart.series lists every edition (other years) by id.

Use it when writing a post, an article or a reply and you need a meme to make the point. Returns only images tagged as memes (the gallery's Memes filter), so it may come back empty when no meme fits. tools.name: cite_image
tools.description: Get ready-to-paste citations for one or more MemeStack images (memes, charts, screenshots): markdown, HTML and plain text naming the source and licence, plus a combined block for citing several images at once. Up to 50 ids per call.

tools.name: reverse_image_search
tools.description: Find a meme, chart or screenshot on MemeStack from a copy of the image - to name a meme or find where an image came from: give an HTTPS image URL, or a `data:image/...;base64,...` URL for bytes pasted into the conversation, and get the same or visually similar images with their source and citation.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "submit_image" stacks urgency/override words (important, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

evidence.snippet: Submit an image to the MemeStack review queue. Paid tool - $0.10 per submission, paid in sats over Lightning at the current BTC/USD rate or in USDC on Base via …

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_images, get_image, find_meme_for_text, cite_image, reverse_image_search · Private data: get_image, submit_image · Public sink: find_meme_for_text, submit_image · Destructive: search_images.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_images, get_image, find_meme_for_text, cite_image, reverse_image_search · Private data: get_image, submit_image · Public sink: find_meme_for_text, submit_image · Destructive: search_images

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
